messages:
Elliot: Hey team, quick sync / launch social ops for next Mon. Need hero image, 1:1 crop, two caption tracks (benchmark vs dev), UTMs, and three short follow-ups for X. Can we land assets by EOD today?
Maya: Yep, uploading hero and 1:1 now to `s3://redwood-marketing/launch/1749998888/`. Filenames: hero_v5.png, hero_1x1_v3.png.
Rohit: I'll prepare two copy tracks. Benchmark = numbers-first, Developer = integration-first. Will include one pinned reply with webinar CTA.
SchedBot: Reserved slot Mon 08:00-11:00 PT for organic push. No conflicts.
Elliot: CTA strings: Primary = "Get early access". Webinar pin = "Save your seat: redwood.ai/webinar?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=slate_launch". HubSpot form -> list `slate_launch_2026`.
Maya: Added a 6s loop MP4 fallback and a small GIF for X. README updated with alt text.
Rohit: Draft micro-replies (short for X):
- A1: "Which model/seq did you benchmark?"
- A2: "Nice numbers can you drop TL;DR?"
- A3: "Want a quick demo clip?"
- B1: "How long to integrate?"
- B2: "SDKs/examples?"
- B3: "Hosted option?"
Elliot: Shorten tone for X (drop articles). Keep LI slightly longer with bullets. Pin webinar CTA in reply #1 on X.
HubBot: HubSpot form `hs_slate_26` live, mapping to list `slate_launch_2026`. Webhook to `#leads-launch` enabled. Tags: `source:social_slate` added.
Maya: Queues set to HOLD until Elliot signs off. I'll release once you approve copy by 4:30pm PT.
Elliot: Will review and sign off by 5pm unless issues. Thanks — aiming for clean lead routing and <1% ad boost spend initially to seed retargeting.
